description: This file defines the Smarty_Internal_Config_File_Compiler class, which handles compiling Smarty configuration files by invoking lexer and parser components, managing parsing state, handling errors, and generating compiled template code.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Config_File_Compiler
classes.description: Main class responsible for compiling Smarty configuration files, involving lexing, parsing, error handling, and generating the compiled output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the compiler with specified lexer and parser classes and Smarty object, setting up initial configuration data structures.

methods.name: compileTemplate
methods.description: Compiles a Smarty internal template by lexing and parsing its source, handling debugging, and producing the final compiled code.

methods.name: trigger_config_file_error
methods.description: Handles syntax errors or parser exceptions in config files, generating detailed error messages including line content and expected tokens.
